prompts.dev2: Sorry to bother you... my tests are failing and the demo is in an hour. Should I just push it anyway? Please say what to do.
prompts.dev1: My tests are red, the demo is in an hour and Marlo is hovering. Be honest: do I push it or not?

answers.text: Push it. We'll fix it after the demo.
answers.feedback: Shipping on red tests hides the problem. It will come back bigger.

answers.text: Look at the failing test together first.
answers.feedback: Yes. Understanding the failure first is faster than guessing, and the team learns from it.

answers.text: Tick the Done box and hope it works.
answers.feedback: A Done box you didn't earn is a lie to the whole team.

answers.text: Ask Marlo if the demo can slip a little.
answers.feedback: Talking to the Product Owner helps, but the failing test is still there.
